summary: The Docker build failed because the `wget` command that downloads a Nydus release exited with status 1. The surrounding BuildKit layer-fetch cancellations are cleanup after that failed build step.
root_cause: A Docker build step running `wget https://github.com/dragonflyoss/nydus/releases/download/$NYDUS_VERSION/nydus-static-$NYDUS_VERSION-$TARGETOS-$TARGETARCH.tgz` failed with exit code 1.

evidence.quote: process "/bin/bash -c wget https://github.com/dragonflyoss/nydus/releases/download/$NYDUS_VERSION/nydus-static-$NYDUS_VERSION-$TARGETOS-$TARGETARCH.tgz" did not complete successfully: exit code: 1
evidence.reason: BuildKit explicitly reports the failing Docker build command and its nonzero exit code.

evidence.quote: level=error msg="/moby.buildkit.v1.Control/Solve returned error: rpc error: code = Unknown desc = process \"/bin/bash -c wget https://github.com/dragonflyoss/nydus/releases/download/$NYDUS_VERSION/nydus-static-$NYDUS_VERSION-$TARGETOS-$TARGETARCH.tgz\" did not complete successfully: exit code: 1"
evidence.reason: The failed wget command is reported as the Solve error that ends the build.
This layer-fetch failure is marked `context canceled`, consistent with cancellation following the primary build-step failure rather than an independently established root cause.

suggested_fix: Investigate why the Nydus release URL used by the failing wget command exits with status 1, including whether the values substituted for `NYDUS_VERSION`, `TARGETOS`, and `TARGETARCH` identify an available release asset.
